message.text:
The first enforcement site is `checkMemoReadAccess` in `memo_service.go`, covering `GetMemo` and comments.

Other enforcement sites include attachment access in `attachment_service.go`, file server permissions in `fileserver.go`, RSS in `rss.go`, frontend sitemap in `frontend.go`, SSE in `sse_hub.go`, email notifications in `canViewerAccessMemo`, reactions in `reaction_service.go`, and list memo attachments in `memo_attachment_service.go`.

The distinct enforcement sites are the gRPC/Connect API, HTTP file server, RSS, frontend sitemap, and SSE hub. Named functions include `checkMemoReadAccess` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, `checkAttachmentAccess` in `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go`, `checkAttachmentPermission` in `fileserver.go`, `RSS VisibilityList` in `rss.go`, `Frontend VisibilityList` in `frontend.go`, `SSEClient.canReceive` in `sse_hub.go`, and `canViewerAccessMemo` in `notification/email.go`.

I will identify every distinct server surface that enforces memo visibility and list each one with its file path.

Eight enforcement sites were identified across the codebase. They include `checkMemoReadAccess` and `ListMemos` visibility filters in `memo_service.go`, attachment access checks in `attachment_service.go`, RSS and frontend sitemap public-only queries, SSE client permission checks in `sse_hub.go`, and email notification access logic in `email.go`. These are being grouped by server surface.

The six distinct enforcement surfaces are now grouped clearly. The Connect/gRPC API surface includes `checkMemoReadAccess`, list filters, and inline checks for reactions, comments, and list attachments. The remaining surfaces are the HTTP file server, RSS, frontend sitemap, and SSE hub.

API list/query visibility filters — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go (also memo_service_comments.go, memo_relation_service.go, memo_service_converter.go, user_service_stats.go)  
checkAttachmentAccess — server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go  
checkAttachmentPermission — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go  
RSS public-only listing — server/router/rss/rss.go  
Frontend sitemap public-only listing — server/router/frontend/frontend.go  
SSEClient.canReceive — server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go  
canViewerAccessMemo — server/notification/email.go

Visibility is not only in `GetMemo`. Single-memo API reads go through `checkMemoReadAccess`; list/related-memo queries add `VisibilityList` / CEL `visibility` filters. Linked attachments are gated again on the API (`checkAttachmentAccess`) and on `/file` (`checkAttachmentPermission`). RSS and the sitemap only load `store.Public` memos. Live SSE delivery uses `canReceive` (private events only to the creator/admin). Outbound email uses `canViewerAccessMemo`. Reactions, comments, and `ListMemoAttachments` repeat the same private/public rules inline in those handlers.
